title: [Main]-Test disabled after BCApps uptake: Contract Renewal Test.TestIfContractRenewalSelectionIsUpdateOnAfterValidateCalcBasePercentage fails
summary: Fixed the Contract Renewal Selection page (8006) in Subscription Billing so the selection updates after Calc. Base Percentage is validated. This lets the disabled test TestIfContractRenewalSelectionIsUpdateOnAfterValidateCalcBasePercentage pass again.
key_points: Page 8006 Contract Renewal Selection code was changed (+9 -2)
Targets updating the selection after Calc. Base Percentage is validated
Re-enables a Contract Renewal Test case that was disabled after BCApps uptake
